title_en: NED Eric Cordless Table Lamp, Rechargeable Dimmable Accent Light with Adjustable Color Temperature, Sand Cashmere
title_zh: NED Eric 无线台灯，可充电调光氛围灯，色温可调，沙色

bullets.en: Cordless ambient light: A compact, rechargeable lamp that moves from a bedside table to a dining setting or a favorite corner. Use it without a cord once charged.
bullets.zh: 无线氛围光：小巧可充电，可从床头移到餐桌或喜欢的角落；充电后可无线使用。

bullets.en: One-knob control: Press to switch on or off, turn to dim from 5% to 100%, and press and turn to adjust the color temperature from 2,700K to 4,000K.
bullets.zh: 一键旋钮控制：按压开关，旋转将亮度从 5% 调至 100%，按压并旋转可将色温从 2,700K 调至 4,000K。

bullets.en: Up to 8 hours: Enjoy up to 8 hours of light on a full charge, depending on brightness. Charging takes approximately 6 hours. A charging cord is included; a power adapter is not included.
bullets.zh: 最长约 8 小时：充满电后最长可照明 8 小时，续航随亮度变化。充电约需 6 小时；附充电线，不含电源适配器。

bullets.en: Compact, rounded form: Approximately 7.9 inches high and 4.3 inches in diameter (20.1 x 11 cm). Made with powder-coated aluminum in Sand Cashmere.
bullets.zh: 小巧圆润的造型：约 7.9 英寸高、直径 4.3 英寸（20.1 × 11 厘米），采用沙色粉末喷涂铝材质。

bullets.en: Indoor and outdoor settings: NED lists an IP65 rating for outdoor use and recommends bringing the lamp indoors after outdoor use.
bullets.zh: 适用于室内及户外：NED 标示产品为 IP65 防护等级，并建议户外使用后将灯收回室内。

description_en: The NED Eric Table Lamp brings adjustable ambient light and a rounded silhouette to everyday spaces. Its compact, cordless design moves from a bedside table to a dining setting or a favorite corner. The Sand Cashmere finish adds a warm, understated touch.

Use the top knob to switch the lamp on or off, adjust the brightness from 5% to 100%, and adjust color temperature from 2,700K to 4,000K. Made with powder-coated aluminum, it measures approximately 7.9 inches high by 4.3 inches in diameter (20.1 x 11 cm).

A full charge provides up to 8 hours of light, depending on brightness; charging takes approximately 6 hours. A charging cord is included; a power adapter is not included. NED lists an IP65 rating and recommends bringing the lamp indoors after outdoor use.
description_zh: NED Eric 台灯以圆润造型与可调节的氛围光融入日常空间。小巧无线的设计适合从床头移动到餐桌或喜欢的角落，沙色饰面带来温暖、克制的视觉感受。
按压顶部旋钮可开关灯具；旋转调节 5%–100% 亮度，按压并旋转调节 2,700K–4,000K 色温。产品采用粉末喷涂铝材质，约 7.9 英寸高、直径 4.3 英寸（20.1 × 11 厘米）。
充满电后最长可照明 8 小时，续航随亮度变化；充电约需 6 小时。附充电线，不含电源适配器。NED 标示产品为 IP65 防护等级，并建议户外使用后收回室内。
